item.title: Prudential Paid Out RM1m In Medical Claims To A Policyholder In 2025
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Prudential paid out RM1.04 million in claims in one policy year to a policyholder undergoing breast cancer treatment in 2025, saying medical plans with RM50k-RM100k annual limits were common in 2013 but are no longer adequate for today’s health care needs.
